title: Coefficient dual of a constant finite module
statement: Let X be a scheme, Lambda a commutative noetherian ring, and M a finitely generated Lambda-module. The internal Hom from the constant sheaf M_X [def-constructible-constant] to the monoidal unit Lambda_X is isomorphic to the constant sheaf associated to Hom_Lambda(M,Lambda). No nonemptiness or connectedness hypothesis on X is needed.

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring, local finite presentation argument

proof.text: Noetherianity and finite generation give a finite free presentation Lambda^m → Lambda^n → M → 0. The constant sheaf functor is exact (preserves finite limits and colimits, as in ConstantSheafOver), so this gives a cokernel presentation of M_X.

Tensoring by any test sheaf preserves colimits. By tensor-Hom adjunction, internalHom(-,Lambda_X) takes the presentation cokernel to the kernel between the internal duals of the two finite free constant sheaves. This kernel property follows by applying Hom from an arbitrary test sheaf.

The internal dual of Lambda_X is Lambda_X by the unit constraint. The finite biproduct tensor-Hom adjunction identifies the duals of the finite free constant sheaves with finite free constant sheaves of the same ranks. Evaluation on the basis summands identifies the induced map with constant sheafification of the transposed presentation matrix.

Constant sheafification preserves the kernel of that matrix. Hom_Lambda(-,Lambda) applied to the original presentation identifies this module kernel with Hom_Lambda(M,Lambda). Compose the two kernel identifications to obtain the asserted isomorphism. The argument still holds for zero modules, zero coefficient ring, and empty X.

theorem nonempty_constant_finite_dual_iso (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    [Module.Finite Λ M] :
    Nonempty ((ihom ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj
      (𝟙_ _) ≅ (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of Λ (M →ₗ[Λ] Λ)))
